title: How Eagles' win over Steelers could make things messier | unCovering the Birds
channel_name: unCovering the Birds with Jeff McLane
text: Nick Sirianni’s fate with the Eagles beyond 2026 is far from certain. But Sunday’s 19-16 win over Pittsburgh produced an important sign: the Eagles’ determined performance suggests the head coach still has a grip on his team - at least for now.
